Foreground microphone, mono PCM 48 kHz, up to 60 s in memory. Audio is neither saved nor transmitted. Press stop to decode. Robot36 needs the full header and at least 37 s: start before the transmission. No PTT, TX or continuous decoding; test with known audio first.
No capture. Granting permission does not start recording: press start again after granting it.
Recording microphone. 60 s limit; leaving this screen cancels and discards the audio.
Capture cancelled. No audio is kept and nothing resumes automatically.
Use a tone from 300 to 1200 Hz and a speed from 5 to 45 WPM.
Permission granted. Press start to begin a new capture.
No microphone permission. You can still use the WAV importers without recording audio.
The image was lost when the screen was recreated. Decode a new capture.
Experimental USB/CAT, Bricohams SAT RX v1 only. Not physically tested on Android.

Bricohams Beta - USB OTG: CDC ACM and recognized single-port CH34x, CP210x, FTDI or Prolific adapters. On the radio: SAT RX and key 8 for CAT RX. No channels, EEPROM or calibration. Tuning expires after 3 s without renewal.
Recording Robot36 (max. 60 s). Doppler or CAT tuning remain active. Press Stop when the image ends.

SSTV Robot36. RX: start Doppler or tune, connect the radio speaker to the phone microphone and record. TX: audio cable from the phone to the radio microphone input; on the radio arm CAT PTT with key 9 in SAT RX. Transmits on the VFO TX frequency, respects TX lock and bands, cuts off after 120 s, and any radio key aborts. Callsign required: it is printed on the image. Requires a license and a frequency authorized for SSTV.
Enter MHz in 10 Hz steps, VHF 136-174 or UHF 400-470.
No recognized single-port USB device. Check OTG, cable and firmware. An arbitrary device is never used instead.
Waiting for USB permission. Nothing connects without Android authorization.
USB permission response expired or from another device. Choose USB again.
USB permission denied or request expired. Choose the device again.
USB STOP not confirmed: %1$s. Check nominal RX on the radio.

Selected pass: %1$s
AOS %2$s
LOS %3$s
Nominal downlink %4$s Hz. Connect USB and press Start only during this pass; there is no delayed start and no TX.
Unsupported plan: %1$s. Tracking is not offered.
Checking current pass and CAT state. Temporary reception only, no TX.
Doppler RX confirmed %1$d Hz. Azimuth %2$.1f, elevation %3$.1f degrees. SGP4 calculation, not an RF measurement. Stopping disconnects USB.
Bricohams Beta - SSTV Robot36 from WAV, experimental.

Only mono 16-bit PCM WAV, 8/16/24/32/40/48 kHz, 37-60 s and up to 8 MiB. Requires a complete VIS 8 header and a 240-line image. Does not use the microphone, USB audio or PTT. No clock drift correction; not equivalent to full Robot36. Keep this screen open and export the PNG before leaving or rotating.
Decoded SSTV Robot36 image; check for possible visual errors.
Processing SSTV. Nothing is transmitted and the radio is not modified.

PNG saved; check the file at the chosen destination.
SSTV not completed: %1$s. If you were exporting, discard the partial file.

Import current TLEs from a file or paste their two lines. Manual observer position, height in km. Only one-off VHF/UHF FM downlink confirmed by you, no TX. 24 h prediction with TLEs up to 7 days old; no data is downloaded and the satellite mode is not verified. No map or automatic GPS on this screen.
Calculate passes for the next 24 h

Go back to ARDF and request a position when you are ready.
A phone position is requested for up to 30 s. It is only saved when you record an observation and is included in the exported JSON. There is no background tracking.
Available offline: local logbook with search, ADIF import with preview, ADIF/JSON export, ARDF sessions and one-off GPS observations, text Morse and experimental PCM WAV.

Experimental CAT RX over USB OTG, CDC and recognized USB-serial adapters. Offline SGP4 satellites with imported TLEs, manual observer, passes and Doppler RX tracking. SSTV Robot36 from WAV with PNG. Morse/Robot36 microphone capture of up to 60 s with later decoding. Beta Quansheng F4HWN v6 channel editor (frequency, sub-tones and power) with full backup and read-back. Pending: signed LoTW upload.
ARDF observations are manual. The position is the phone\'s, not a beacon\'s. No track is recorded and there is no background location.
No data is collected or transmitted. The JSON includes positions and contacts: share it only with the right people.
Contacts, sessions and observations are added. Nothing is deleted or overwritten: a conflicting ID cancels the whole import. Only use trusted backups.
The selected contact no longer exists.
This action cannot be undone. Export your data if you need to keep a copy.
LoTW: this APK exports ADIF. Signing and uploading must be done with TQSL on a computer; there is no LoTW upload from Android.
Unsaved forms are discarded when switching sections.
Search this logbook: call, notes, mode or frequency
Showing the 50 most recent matches; export includes the entire logbook, not just the search.
Create a session to record observations.
Interval between first and last: %1$.1f s
Sum of accepted GPS segments: %1$.1f m (%2$d segments)

This is neither a complete track nor the distance to the beacon. Only consecutive phone positions with accuracy <=50 m, age <=30 s and separation <=120 s; gaps are not joined and missing stretches are not estimated.
Mean interval: not available with a single observation
The coordinate is only saved when you press Save. Without a recent position it is explicitly saved without GPS. No coordinate represents the beacon location.
Export sessions and contacts as JSON
Text Morse: spaces between letters and / between words; ? marks an unknown code.

Experimental audio: import mono 16-bit PCM WAV, 8-48 kHz, 0.1-60 s and up to 8 MiB. Set the actual tone and speed. Does not use the microphone or listen over USB. Not an adaptive decoder; verify the result.
Tone 300-1200 Hz and speed 5-45 WPM, both integers.

About 37 s will be transmitted on the radio VFO TX frequency with callsign %1$s on the image. Check your license, authorized frequency, audio cable to the microphone and PTT armed with key 9. Any radio key stops the transmission.

Quansheng F4HWN v6 channel editor (Beta). Existing FM channels only: frequency, sub-tones and power. Steps: connect, full backup, read, edit, apply and write with read-back.
